title: Home Oxygen Therapy Contents Months: Treatment of High and Low Prescribed Flow
content:
# High and Low Prescribed Flow in a Contents Month — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy contents month paid in full by the coverage, the class's post-cap contents monthly fee is first adjusted for the prescribed flow on the oxygen record:

1. when that flow is above the class's high-flow threshold (**4 LPM**), the class furnishes a conserving device and at least one cylinder refill is on record, the conserving device holds down the gas used at high flow, so a flat **12.5 dollars** is added to the contents fee instead of any percentage raise;
2. otherwise, when the flow is above that threshold, the contents fee is raised by the class's high-flow uplift percentage (**50 percent**);
3. otherwise, when the flow is below the class's low-flow threshold (**1 LPM**), the contents fee is reduced by the class's low-flow reduction percentage (**50 percent**) and the reduced fee is then compared with **25.00 dollars**, the higher of the two being kept;
4. otherwise the contents fee is unchanged.

## Conserving device by class

| System class | Conserving device furnished |
|---|---|
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | yes |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | yes |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | no |
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390), Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738), Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | no |

## Decision table

| Flow | Conserving device and a cylinder refill on record | Treatment of the contents fee |
|---|---|---|
| above 4 LPM | both | add 12.5 dollars, no percentage raise |
| above 4 LPM | either missing | raise by 50 percent |
| below 1 LPM | — | reduce by 50 percent, then keep the higher of that and 25.00 |
| 1 to 4 LPM inclusive | — | unchanged |

## Worked figures

- Contents fee 79.12 at 6 LPM, conserving device furnished and refills on record: 79.12 plus 12.5 is 91.62.
- Contents fee 79.12 at 6 LPM, no conserving device: 79.12 raised by 50 percent is 118.68.
- Contents fee 79.12 at 0.5 LPM: reduced by 50 percent is 39.56, higher than 25.00, so 39.56.
- A hypothetical contents fee of 40.00 at 0.5 LPM: reduced by 50 percent is 20.00, lower than 25.00, so 25.00.

The adjusted figure is carried as it stands, with no rounding at this point.
